hints.idea: A Source pushes all the time.

say: Your goal is to wire its control board to make it reach the ring ahead.
Objectives are what the level asks. Here, get into the ring before the 10 s are out.
The window has two tabs: Run plays the level and the Editor builds the control board.
Click the Editor tab or the Editor button now.
The board is your swimmer's body, its front to the right. Click a cell, and the Wheel, in Tools, shows what goes there.
The nav bar opens the drawers: Tools, Parts, Files, Diagnostic, Navigator. At its foot: Hints, Settings, Chapters, and Run.
A Source sends beads all the time; a thruster pushes as hard as beads come in.
Click the Source, in the middle, then the thruster behind it: a wire joins them.
Click the Run tab, or Run at the bottom left.
Press Play, or Space: the swimmer goes straight into the ring.
That is all it takes: a wire from what senses to what acts.
If you are stuck, try clicking Hints.
